plan.summary: RI-1A/1B: LLM benchmark endpoint with multi-model comparison (Claude Haiku, Claude Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash) plus tiered classification (Gemini 2.5 Flash primary + Claude Haiku escalation at <0.80 confidence). Samples threads from customer MSSQL, masks PII, classifies with all models, stores denormalized results with per-model metrics.
plan.q_intent: LLM benchmark API endpoint yaz — Claude Haiku, Sonnet, Gemini Flash, Pro, 3 Flash karsilastir. Ucuz modelleri takim haline getir (tiered: Flash primary + Haiku escalation).
plan.interview_notes: Q decided Option C (tiered) after seeing benchmark results: 3 cheap models had 9/10 unanimous agreement. Gemini 2.5 Flash + Claude Haiku escalation at <0.80 confidence chosen for production use.

files_changed.change: Benchmark DB schema (wa_benchmark_jobs + wa_benchmark_results + tiered columns)
CRUD for benchmark jobs and results (batch INSERT 25 cols, parameterized queries)
DTOs: BenchmarkJob, BenchmarkResult (incl Tiered fields), LlmClassification, SampledThread
DI for 6 keyed ILlmClient services (incl tiered), 5 benchmark API endpoints, catch(JsonException)
6-stage pipeline with typed catches (HttpRequestException, SqlException, InvalidOperationException)
BackgroundService with typed catches (Http, InvalidOp, Npgsql, SqlException)
Accuracy, macro-F1, per-label precision/recall/F1, label distribution
System prompt + thread formatter for LLM classification
Tiered: Gemini Flash primary + Claude Haiku escalation at <0.80 confidence
Google Generative AI REST client implementing ILlmClient
Polymorphic LLM client interface: ModelName, IsAvailable, ClassifyAsync
Regex-based PII redaction (phone, email, TCKN, IBAN, URL incl www.)
Made BuildConnectionString internal for benchmark MSSQL access
DetectOutcome visibility: private -> internal for keyword baseline
Added Gemini, ClaudeSonnet, Benchmark config sections

verification_questions.question: Are all LLM API keys read from config (not hardcoded) and never logged or exposed in error messages?
Does the PII masker correctly redact phone numbers, emails, TCKN, IBAN, and URLs before sending thread text to external LLM APIs?
Does the tiered classifier correctly escalate to the fallback model when primary confidence is below threshold, and take the higher-confidence result?
Are SQL parameters properly parameterized in all MSSQL queries (no string concatenation/injection vectors)?
Does the benchmark orchestrator correctly handle model failures (null results, consecutive errors, unavailable models) without crashing the entire job?

intentional_exclusions: No automated test suite (benchmark is itself a test tool)
No tenant-scoped auth (ops-level tool with X-Ops-Key)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: LLM failures return null and are counted. 5+ consecutive errors skip the model with a logged warning. Job-level errors are caught and stored in error_message column.

aha_moments.user_pain: Running 6 LLM models sequentially on 200 threads takes too long for quick comparisons
aha_moments.suggestion: Add a 'quick' mode that runs only tiered model on 10 samples for instant validation
aha_moments.aha_moment: Q sees tiered results in under 30 seconds instead of waiting 20+ minutes for all models

aha_moments.user_pain: Tiered escalation wastes Haiku calls if Flash consistently produces high confidence on certain label types
aha_moments.suggestion: Track escalation rate per label and auto-tune threshold per category
aha_moments.aha_moment: Escalation rate drops from 20% to 8% after learning which labels Flash handles confidently

aha_moments.user_pain: Benchmark results are raw JSON — hard to compare models visually for sales demos
aha_moments.suggestion: Add a /api/ops/benchmark/{id}/report endpoint returning formatted HTML comparison table
aha_moments.aha_moment: Q opens one URL and sees a clean model comparison dashboard ready to show stakeholders

aha_moments.user_pain: No way to know if benchmark is progressing or stuck — only polling status endpoint
aha_moments.suggestion: Add SSE endpoint for real-time progress updates during benchmark execution
aha_moments.aha_moment: Q watches live progress bar showing 'Classifying with tiered(flash+haiku): 47/200 threads'

aha_moments.user_pain: When a model produces unexpected labels, debugging requires reading raw evidence for each thread
aha_moments.suggestion: Add disagreement filter to results endpoint — show only threads where models disagree
aha_moments.aha_moment: Q instantly finds the 3 threads where models disagree and understands why classification differs

verdict.override: Q FORCE PASS — remaining Codex failures are false positives: tenant_id intentionally omitted (ops-level tool), MSSQL reads customer data (not our DB), GRANT pattern matches existing codebase, UNKNOWN verdicts from chunking
